coverage_gaps: PubMed-only routing may miss pre-indexed records, curated variant databases, patents, trial registries, and non-indexed structural or proteomic datasets.
Search abstracts may not expose complete ancestry definitions, assay conditions, substrate-site validation, negative results, or conflict-of-interest details that require full-text review.
Rare variants and variants of uncertain significance may have evidence too sparse or heterogeneous for stable classification.
Model-specific substrate phosphorylation may not demonstrate causal relevance in human dopaminergic neurons or Parkinson disease progression.
Clinical inhibitor studies available by the cutoff may provide limited evidence on long-term target engagement, disease modification, and tissue-specific safety.
Publication and ancestry biases may restrict generalization of penetrance and risk estimates across populations.
exclusion_criteria: Studies mentioning LRRK2 or Parkinson disease only incidentally without genetic, mechanistic, substrate, physiological, or limiting evidence.
Unreviewed commentary, opinion, news, conference abstracts without sufficient methods or results, and duplicate reports lacking additional evidence.
Purely computational predictions without experimental validation or informative human genetic support.
Claims based solely on nonphysiological overexpression when no endogenous, genetic, biochemical, or orthogonal validation is available.
Studies of unrelated parkinsonian disorders that do not report separable evidence for LRRK2-associated Parkinson disease.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed-indexed records published on or before 2024-12-31.
Primary human genetic studies that establish linkage, identify variants, estimate association, or quantify penetrance and phenotype.
Primary biochemical, structural, cellular, animal, or human-biospecimen studies that directly test LRRK2 enzymatic activity, regulation, substrates, or downstream physiology.
Systematic reviews, consensus statements, and high-quality narrative reviews used for orientation and citation chaining, with central claims checked against primary studies.
Studies reporting null, discordant, tissue-specific, ancestry-specific, model-dependent, or safety findings relevant to limits of the proposed mechanism.
Evidence must distinguish pathogenic mutations, risk alleles, protective alleles or haplotypes, and variants of uncertain significance when those categories are discussed.

queries.purpose: Establish the overall evidence landscape and identify landmark reviews and primary studies.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "PARK8"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Trace linkage, positional cloning, and the original genetic discovery chronology.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "PARK8"[Title/Abstract]) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR discover*[Title/Abstract] OR "autosomal dominant"[Title/Abstract] OR familial[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence on established high-impact disease-associated coding variants.
queries.query: ("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "PARK8"[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Expand to ancestry-dependent risk alleles, protective haplotypes, and common-variant association evidence.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract] OR N551K[Title/Abstract] OR R1398H[Title/Abstract] OR GWAS[Title/Abstract] OR "genome-wide association"[Title/Abstract]) AND Parkinson*[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Confirm penetrance, population frequency, founder effects, ancestry variation, and genotype-phenotype limits.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR prevalence[Title/Abstract] OR ancestry[Title/Abstract] OR population[Title/Abstract] OR founder[Title/Abstract] OR "age dependent"[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR variant*[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Map enzymatic domains and variant-dependent effects on kinase and GTPase regulation.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR "ROC-COR"[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract]) AND (mechanism*[Title/Abstract] OR activat*[Title/Abstract] OR pathogenic[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm physiological Rab substrates, phosphorylation sites, and supporting biochemical or cellular evidence.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteomic*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Connect enzymatic activity and substrates to membrane trafficking, lysosomal physiology, and disease pathways.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR RAB7L1[Title/Abstract] OR lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR endolysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR vesicle*[Title/Abstract] OR trafficking[Title/Abstract]) AND Parkinson*[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Test whether loss-of-function, knockout, and inhibitor findings constrain a simple kinase-gain model or reveal organ-specific liabilities.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND ("loss of function"[Title/Abstract] OR knockout[Title/Abstract] OR inhibition[Title/Abstract] OR inhibitor*[Title/Abstract] OR safety[Title/Abstract] OR toxicity[Title/Abstract]) AND (human*[Title/Abstract] OR animal*[Title/Abstract] OR model*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve explicit counterevidence and limits on mechanism strength, consistency, and generalizability.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (conflict*[Title/Abstract] OR discordant[Title/Abstract] OR heterogeneity[Title/Abstract] OR "incomplete penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR reproducib*[Title/Abstract]) AND Parkinson*[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Assess cell-type and tissue dependence of LRRK2 activity, substrate engagement, and inferred disease relevance.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (brain[Title/Abstract] OR neuron*[Title/Abstract] OR microglia[Title/Abstract] OR macrophage*[Title/Abstract] OR kidney[Title/Abstract] OR lung[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture recent genetic, mechanistic, substrate, biomarker, and synthesis updates within the temporal scope.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] AND (genetic*[Title/Abstract] OR variant*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR Rab[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Search PubMed through 2024-12-31 for human genetic and experimental evidence linking leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 (LRRK2/PARK8) to Parkinson disease, covering discovery chronology, pathogenic and risk/protective variants, kinase and GTPase mechanisms, physiological substrates, and evidence that constrains causality, penetrance, tissue generality, or therapeutic interpretation.
stop_rules: Complete at least one discovery, one confirmation, and one challenge query for each of genetics, enzymatic mechanism, substrates or physiology, and limitations.

Stop landmark citation chaining when two consecutive backward or forward citation passes add no new eligible study that changes the chronology, mechanism, variant classification, or limitation assessment.
Stop terminology expansion when newly encountered synonyms, variant names, substrate names, tissues, or pathway terms yield no new eligible evidence category across two consecutive queries.

Require evidence saturation across discovery chronology, high-penetrance and population-risk variants, kinase and GTPase function, physiological substrates, and counterevidence before ending retrieval.
Retain unresolved contradictions as explicit evidence gaps after targeted challenge retrieval rather than continuing unrestricted searching.
End at the 12-query event budget even if gaps remain, documenting all uncovered or weakly supported dimensions.
